newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to review Italian budget within a few days.
newsitem.headline: EU to review Italian budget within a few days.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to begin a review of the Italian government's 1997 budget plan within a few days to examine the merits of the so-called "euro tax," officials said on Thursday.
"We are still waiting for the budget," said one Commission official. "It should be arriving in a few days."

The controversial euro tax is a key part of Italy's 1997 budget -- which cleared the lower house of parliament at the weekend -- tailored to lop 62.5 trillion lire off the 1997 public deficit and speed Italy on its way to EMU membership by 1999.

Commission officials said they were initially unaware that the proposed tax would in effect be returned to taxpayers after a specified period, an arrangement which under normal circumstances would be classified as a loan.
They added that depending on the outcome of the review, Eurostat, the EU's statistical office, might be asked to offer its own evaluation.

Should such a review determine that the tax could not be applied towards Italy's 1997 budget, the outlook for Italy's deficit would by implication be higher than the 3.3 percent of total output forecast by the Commission in October. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
